name: Glow Flat
reads_as: A saturated flat world that glows: a deep indigo ground graded into colour fields, gloss-shaded shapes with no outlines (a darker inner band and one bright highlight), saturated pill labels on things, soft light shafts and glows, something alive in every frame, one meaning-carrying change at a time. Inspired by the newer Kurzgesagt look as measured in docs/research/kurz/ (techniques only; every design is original).

characters._extras_note: what a background person is (D-100): people = the cast's rigs in muted clothes; silhouette = the grey bean; none = no crowd. Change it here, never per lesson.
characters._hair_note: 2026-10-07: the old hair colours (#2A1E3A, #3B2A20, #1C1A2E) measured 1.07 to 1.33:1 on the field, so dark hair vanished into the ground (rigs ava and sam have no outline). These keep natural families (black-brown, dark brown, soft black, auburn) and lift them to 1.6 to 3.0:1 on field. A cool blue-black (#3F3F66) was tried and read as grey hair in the preview, so every colour keeps a warm undertone. Never the ink token (L-92).
characters._cloth_note: 2026-10-07: cloth was accent4, the same cyan as the default pill, hud and label tone, so the cast wore the meaning colour in every frame (stress-signal b05: dress, Cortisol pill and status panel all one cyan). Muted (lavender) keeps people neutral; a scene may still dress one person in an accent on purpose with top: <token>.

join_note: A small story world: stay in the place and change its state (continue) or pan where places connect; a wipe or a material join (page, torn) at a change of time or chapter, the dip only for a change of era. Not every beat needs a transition: most beats continue.

fx._grain_note: D-100: grain is off or near-off by default; per-pixel noise reads as grit after H.264 on a 1080p MP4 (L-173). A lesson may set storyboard fx.grain to choose a film finish.
fx._vignette_note: 2026-10-07: 0.55 (D-92) was never seen on a glow-flat frame (the lab strips run without fx; stress-signal rendered at 0.24). Simulated with the fx.js formula on a preview frame it takes the corners to #09061F and the frame mean down, while glow-flat lessons already measure darker than their reference (0.25 against 0.42). 0.35 gives a 0.30 corner alpha. Judge on the encoded MP4 (D-100); unverified in Chrome.
fx._colors_note: 2026-10-07: the nebula mixed accent3 (hot pink) into the field, which showed as a pink smudge behind template beats (stress-signal b02 at 13.5 s) and spent a meaning hue on the background. violet and plum keep the ground in one hue family; G.ground covers the shader in bespoke beats anyway.

tone_reference._source: 2026-10-07: brightness, saturation, dark and light shares measured with loom/checks/film.py _tone (the film check's own measure) on 341 keyframes of the five newer Kurzgesagt videos in the requester's folder (studied privately, nothing kept). The TED-Ed glow_technical_3d family (0.48, 0.47, 0.17, 0.22) flagged every glow-flat lesson as too saturated (0.70 against 0.47) though saturation is this register's point. warm, cool, accent_shots and colours are still the TED-Ed family values (not measured here; the film check does not read them). A reference, not a target (D-112).

pace._why: dark-field pack: glowing shapes on a dark field measure low edge density by design (TED-Ed glow films sat under 0.02 for 43 % of narrated time, D-112)

_line_note: 2026-10-07 style polish: line was the same hex as muted (#BDB6F4, 9.66:1), so every connector, axis, arrow and floor line was as loud as secondary text, in a register whose reference separates shapes by colour and light, not lines (outline share 0.008 to 0.012, docs/research/kurz). #8E85D8 holds 5.62:1 on field and 3.95:1 on surface (lint floor 3.0), one step below muted. Text never uses line (grep runtime/templates, blueprints).

materials._decor_note: 2026-10-08 (L-276), from guide s2: a beat is the field family plus ONE accent family, so set decorations and default object tones spend no accent: lights are light (window lights and the spark bulb core, warm light; rack LEDs glow and core, electric and warm light), the vessel is plum (a colour field; accent3 is alarms, never backgrounds), cells, chart bars and objects are violet and muted (neutral pill, neutral objects), the package surface (sets: a warehouse of muted packages measured 13.9 % of the frame, over muted's 10 %), cables line (connectors) with violet and muted (plum is never a line colour), the safety line muted. The document is violet, as the calendar, because a surface document draws its header in the accent. Left at the runtime default: phone surface2. The laptop reads no tone.
